question: On Wednesday morning a paint plant had 170 tins of base white, and 126 tins were used up on a hotel job. At midday a delivery doubled the number of tins in the store. During the afternoon the plant tinted 6 tins of colour from every tin of base. In the evening the depot ordered that whole batch for each of its 5 branches, needing that many tins per branch. The plant lists drying times in hours although the labels give them in minutes. How many tins were ordered altogether?

A gaming server starts a tournament with 93 registered players. A promotional push multiplies signups by 7 overnight. The next day, word spreads and the player count doubles again. A regional broadcast then multiplies the roster by 6. Finally, a global stream multiplies the roster by 6 once more. How many players are registered now?

Mo had 86 dollars in her savings account. She deposited 11 dollars from her paper round, then withdrew 73 dollars for a new coat, and later deposited 10 dollars from a birthday card. The bank's young saver bonus then made her balance 3 times what it had been. She deposited 17 dollars from babysitting and 6 dollars from returning bottles. How many dollars are in Mo's account now?

A person had 199 dollars initially. They tripled by multiplying by 3. They added 28 for gifts. Then removed 465 for expenses. They added 29 back from refunds. They added 64 more from bonus. Finally, 73 more arrived. A wealthy person had 1000 dollars but separate account. How many dollars total?

A business starts with 145 units. It multiplies by 7 (1015). It multiplies by 5 (5075). It divides by 5 (1015). It multiplies by 4 (4060). Time measurement from minutes to hours noted. How much is the total?

Sofia counted 197 eggs in the farm's cold room on Friday morning. A restaurant order took 182 of them straight away. She then found 9 eggs cracked in their trays and threw those out. Her colleague Anton, who keeps far fewer hens than Sofia does, borrowed 2 for the staff kitchen. On Saturday the hens gave 74 more eggs, and a neighbouring farm sent 13 across as a thank-you. Anton has worked on this farm for a dozen seasons. How many eggs are in the cold room now?

A science lab ordered 132 crates of test tubes, and each crate held 7 tubes. The tubes were split evenly into 2 equal stores, and the annexe store is the one being followed. Breakages cost the annexe 136 tubes, and 290 tubes were transferred to another school. The supplier then delivered 8 tubes for every tube left in the annexe. The lab records reaction times in seconds although its reports are written in minutes. How many tubes are in the annexe store now?

A school car wash charges 9 quarters per car. On each of 2 days, 30 cars came through. The students changed all the quarters into dollars, at 4 quarters to the dollar. They spent 34 dollars on soap and 10 dollars on wax. How many dollars do they have left?

A warehouse tracked packages. Morning inventory: 180 items. He divided by 4 for distribution zones. He added 63 to one zone. He added 73 to another zone. He subtracted 123 damaged items. He multiplied by 3 for next quarter orders. A team had mentioned he had a dozen extra boxes. How many items are ordered for next quarter?

A restaurant started with 78 meals. They subtracted 66 meals sold by noon. They multiplied the remaining by 6. They added 6 more meals. They multiplied by 5. Then they multiplied by 9. How many meals does the restaurant have?

A football team had 101 minutes booked for each training session, but the coach cancelled 66 minutes of drills, leaving each session at a little over half an hour. The team trains 9 sessions a week, and adds 27 minutes of stretching each week. The club runs 2 teams on exactly the same programme, and the season lasts 9 weeks. How many minutes of training does the club run in the season?

A factory starts with 197 units of raw material. They lose 6 to defects (191). They multiply by 9 for production scheduling (1719). They lose 878 in processing (841). They multiply by 6 for supply planning (5046). They lose 1323 to shrinkage. How much material remains in inventory?

A workshop started with 141 items. They added 11 items. They multiplied by 9. Their partner had 300 items. They multiplied by 8. They divided by 2 equally. They doubled it again for two locations. How many per location?

In the morning, Mira started a fundraising jar, and each of her 5 friends put 66 dollars into it. She then divided the jar's money equally into 2 jars and kept only 1 of them, giving the other to the school. The jar is 30 centimetres tall. In the afternoon her neighbour added 35 dollars to Mira's jar, and Mira took out 20 dollars to buy poster paint. In the evening a local business promised to make the jar's contents 4 times as large, and it did. How many dollars are in Mira's jar now?

Two investors, Marcus and Sarah, track their portfolios. Marcus started with 126 dollars. He earned 29 more through dividends. He then doubled his account through a promotion. All of this was multiplied by 8 through reinvestment. Then 1774 dollars were subtracted due to market losses. How many dollars does Marcus have in his final portfolio?

Tom had 79 trading cards at the start. He doubled his collection by finding 79 more. Then he acquired 55 additional cards from a trade and 18 more from a purchase. Later, he gave away 120 cards. His friend had 200 cards but didn't trade. How many cards did Tom have after the trade but before the giveaway?

Aiden starts a marble tournament with 63 marbles in his bag. He loses 11 marbles in the first round to his opponent. His remaining marbles are then split evenly into 2 side-pouches for the second round, and the story follows just one of those pouches from here. That pouch's marbles are split evenly into 2 more pouches for a final challenge, and the story follows just one of those pouches from here. His rival, Chloe, still has 25 marbles left in her own bag at this point in the tournament. He then loses 8 marbles in the final challenge. A last consolation round costs him 2 more marbles. How many marbles does Aiden have in his pouch now?

Sarah started with 41 songs on her playlist. She added 21 songs in the morning. She added 60 more songs in the afternoon. She removed 36 songs that were too long. She removed another 67 songs she didn't like anymore. She doubled her playlist size. How many songs did Sarah's playlist contain at the end?

Marek had 49 seed trays and gave 18 of them to the allotment society. Each tray he kept holds 4 pots. Every pot grew 9 sunflower seedlings this spring. His friend Odette, who planted fewer trays than Marek, gave him 7 spare seedlings, and the garden centre added 17 more. A school then took 823 seedlings for its planting day. How many seedlings does Marek have left?

Nina had 143 minutes of raw footage from the school play and cut 95 minutes of it away. Her editing partner Ross, who had filmed far less than Nina did, handed her 38 minutes from his own camera, and a parent sent in 3 minutes shot on a phone. A second fixed camera contributed 63 minutes, and the sound engineer supplied 28 minutes of backstage clips. The archive is catalogued in minutes rather than in hours. How many minutes of footage does Nina have now?

Alex is tallying his garden expenses in minutes, which he will later convert to hours. He starts with 233 minutes of work time. He multiplies his effort by 5 days of work, giving him 1165 units. He then loses 1068 minutes due to weather delays. The next day he gains 3 minutes of extra work time. Finally, he adds 11 more minutes. How much total time, in minutes, did Alex accumulate?

Nora and Dev both collect loyalty points at the Corner Cafe. Nora's card showed 54 points, fewer than the 70 points on Dev's card. Nora earned 39 points on a large order, then spent 64 points on a free lunch, and later earned 28 points more. On the cafe's anniversary, every member's point balance was multiplied by 5 as a gift. Each point is worth one cent of credit, and Nora works out her credit in dollars, since a hundred cents make one dollar. How many points does Nora have now?

A production facility started with 63 work units. System downtime removed 53 units (10 units). The remaining work was divided equally by 2 shifts (5 units per shift). One shift was multiplied by 4 (20 units). Bonus overtime added 62 units (82 units). The total was multiplied by 3 (246 units). Final reduction removed 67 units. A neighboring facility had 140 units. What was the final output?

A soccer team had 63 dollars in their equipment fund, saved from 120 minutes, or 2 hours, of a car wash fundraiser. A bake sale added 14 more dollars. A raffle added 52 more. The team spent 71 dollars on new jerseys. A parent donated 29 more dollars. Finally, the team spent 12 dollars on a first-aid kit. How much money was left in the fund?

A school district ordered 239 packs of pencils for each of its 7 year groups. The stockroom manager, Mr Dane, found 49 forgotten packs on a high shelf and 18 packs in the art cupboard. His colleague Mrs Oyelaran, whose own store proved richer than his, contributed 59 packs from the science block and 54 packs from the library. Every pack in the district holds 7 pencils, and the stock list is kept in single pencils rather than in boxes. How many pencils does the district have?
